hook: AI gave me a 47-step plan when I asked how to start a podcast.
caption:
AI gave me a 47-step plan when I asked how to start a podcast.

I asked for help. Not a PhD dissertation.

Here's the thing nobody talks about: AI doesn't know if you're a "just tell me the next step" person or a "give me every possible scenario" person.

So it guesses. And it usually guesses wrong.

The Minimalist Executor (one of our 8 thinking profiles) needs:
→ 3 steps max
→ No caveats
→ No "it depends"
→ Definitely no bullet points with sub-bullets

The Deep Diver sitting next to them? They want the 47 steps. They're upset there weren't 60.

Neither person is wrong. The AI just has no idea which one you are.

This is why copying someone else's "perfect ChatGPT prompt" never quite works for you. Their brain isn't your brain.

BootFile builds your instruction profile so AI stops guessing and starts actually thinking like you do.

One setup. Every conversation after that feels like talking to someone who gets it.

Tag someone who would rage-quit at a 47-step plan. 👇
